title: ATC/1.4 — Agent Trust Card, Unified Verification Profile
description: The canonical wire format for Agent Trust Cards as deployed in the MarketNow production ledger (57 cards). ATC/1.4 formalizes that envelope: card_id + status + payload (schema_version 1.1.0) + signature block (Ed25519/RFC 8032 over RFC 8785 JCS of payload, sha256 signed_payload_hash pre-check, ca_key_id, canonicalization_method). It is a verification UNIFICATION profile, not a new shape: every public verifier (/api/atc, /api/trust, agent-trust-card SDK, marketnow-mcp) accepts this envelope. ATC/1.0 spec cards and atc-v3 multi-sig envelopes remain verifiable with explicit legacy warnings. This profile is intentionally distinct from the draft ATC/2.0 proposal (content-addressed IDs, multi-sig) — see SPEC-v2.md.

status.description: Ledger status. revoked/superseded cards fail verification and appear in the CRL.

decision_authority.description: The card is evidence; the consuming runtime makes the trust decision.

trust.description: Sentinel evidence — review scores, audit layers, risk level. Not a verdict.

value.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes, hex) over the RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization of payload.

canonical_json.description: Documentation of the canonicalization. Accepted spellings: 'RFC_8785_JCS', 'RFC 8785 JCS', 'RFC 8785 JCS (JSON Canonicalization Scheme)'.

signed_payload_hash.description: sha256 hex of the canonical bytes — pre-check before Ed25519 verify; use it to diff canonicalizations byte-for-byte.

ca_key_id.description: Signing CA key id — resolve against the CA key registry (GET /api/atc?action=ca-key). Unknown ids fail closed.

steps: 2. Parse JSON; confirm envelope fields (card_id, status, payload, signature).
5. Ed25519-verify bytes against the CA key resolved from signature.ca_key_id via the CA key registry; unknown or retired-compromised keys fail closed.
6. Check lifecycle: status active, not expired, not in the CRL (GET /api/crl or OCSP /api/ocsp?card_id=...).
7. Consume: the trust block is evidence — the consumer decides.
verification_profile.fail_closed: UNKNOWN = DENY, ERROR = DENY, EXPIRED = DENY, REVOKED = DENY
